entries.title: The climb, race by race, redone: a staircase that builds itself, every one of the 173 races on it

values.label: the staircase (default): a step per series in the order he raced them, every race a dot on its step, higher the more of the field he beat; it builds race by race when it scrolls in
the field: every race's field as a bar hanging from P1, his place notched, the cars he beat in his series' colour
the climb as it was (percentile dots, chapter bands, form line)

entries.look: Career → The climb, race by race. Scroll it in and watch the stairs build (the count ticks to 173). Point at (or tap) any dot: its card, with the track's 3D still where the venue is modelled; click (or tap again) to open the race. The crosses are the 8 races with no classified finish.
